scope: Retrospective training-only ranking audit; no new discovery, proxy matrices, continuations, validation, test or PPO

scores.interaction_only: I = natural-probability-weighted positive four-corner interaction mass
scores.absolute_risk_only: R = maximum supported proxy clearance risk; not a collision probability
scores.absolute_risk_times_interaction: R * I; no fitted coefficient or post-hoc threshold

eligibility: Unchanged production_strict gate before ranking; maximum one ordered pair per state
tie_break: Descending score, ascending source seed, time, ordered actor IDs
unknown_labels: Never zero-fill or infer native outcomes for unaudited state-pair combinations; incomplete native panels return null
mass_law: Uniform selected source, then uniform selected states within source; report reference-bank retained mass separately
collision_source_recall: Retain a labelled collision-positive state-pair from that source, divided by all observed collision sources in the locked eligible training bank; not global or population recall
decision: No automatic winner selection or PPO launch. Same two observed collision sources cannot establish source expansion. A fresh source-disjoint protocol is required after freezing a candidate.
